description: Look up devices by one exact regulatory identifier: FDA 510(k), PMA or De Novo number, UDI-DI (GS1 or HIBCC) or EU Basic UDI-DI. Returns exact_matches (the identifier is the device's primary reference or UDI-DI) and related devices that carry it in another field (a Basic UDI-DI or a submission number often covers several models). Use when the question contains an identifier such as K110287 or a GTIN. Do not use for names or free text (use search_devices) or when the slug is already known (use get_device). Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

identifier.description: One regulatory identifier, 4 to 60 characters: a 510(k) number (e.g. K110287), PMA number (P123456), De Novo number (DEN250023), UDI-DI (GS1 GTIN such as 00884838023703, or HIBCC) or EU Basic UDI-DI. Spaces and letter case are ignored.

name: find_device_by_identifier
title: Find a device by identifier
